title: How to apply for an NBI clearance
content: As of 2026-10-07, you apply for an NBI clearance on the NBI Clearance Application Portal at clearance.nbi.gov.ph. 1. Complete the Applicant Information Form. 2. Click Apply for Clearance. 3. Choose an NBI branch, a date, and a time. 4. Choose a payment method and get a reference number. 5. Go to the branch. Staff take your photo, fingerprints, and signature. With no HIT, you get the clearance within minutes. If the system shows a HIT, you usually return after 5 to 10 working days. Source: https://nbi.gov.ph/how-to-apply-nbi-clearance/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: How to get an SS number and register online with SSS
content: As of 2026-10-07, the SSS assigns each member one lifetime SS Number. Prospective employees, self-employed people, overseas Filipino workers, and non-working spouses apply online. 1. Open the SS Number application on the SSS website. 2. Open the link in the confirmation email within 5 days. 3. Enter your personal details and beneficiaries. 4. Create a My.SSS User ID. 5. Generate your SS Number. You can also apply at an SSS branch E-Center. The page sss.gov.ph/register-to-mysss/ offers a Create account link for My.SSS. Source: https://www.sss.gov.ph/become-an-sss-member/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: Official Philippine passport appointment portal
content: Book a Philippine passport appointment only at passport.gov.ph. Appointments are free. Source: https://passport.gov.ph/sites/site (checked 2026-10-09).

metadata.excerpt: PASSPORT APPOINTMENTS ARE FREE AND SHOULD ONLY BE MADE VIA HTTPS://PASSPORT.GOV.PH.
